review: Reviewed Wren's round-10 request (Cultivate meadow roots: learn and perform a physically feasible way to cultivate edible meadow roots for a renewable personal food supply, from actually acquired inventory, with unknown costs, no assumed propagation and no immediate food) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general 'Cultivate plants' operation with establishment-trial and maintenance modes, parameterized by mode, plant or propagule reference, plot coordinates, quantity and any actually supplied water or amendment. Its specification asks for: reuse of probe for inspection at its cost and of gather for harvest; one owned whole candidate per plot and one plot per execution, revalidated at execution; three checkpointed active rounds at 1 energy each (loosen soil, place input, cover soil), where placement moves the input out of the inventory and covering completes planting, not establishment; refusal of hard or obstructed ground without consumption; growth, rooting and harvest only from executable thresholds of the actual world model; a 10-round first observation interval and a 120-round window as scheduling only; maintenance observation at the probe cost; hand soil-tending (one round, 1 energy) only when a real obstruction or surface condition can be changed; watering only with a measured reachable supply and a transfer method; biomass conservation; and cancel, interruption and death rules without refunds. The review notes that start-0-roots shows stock 0 (capacity 6), so planting must use an owned input such as the five roots in item-4-wren-43. The specification is self-consistent and the existing ecology grounds establishment, growth and harvest, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release; only maintenance is ungrounded and it is refused before any cost. Implemented plant-establishment-trial@1 (scope long-ex18, handler long.plant-establishment-trial, equivalence cultivation:plant-propagule:loosen-place-cover:1, learning 3; the ability serializes to 3,460 code units, within the 3,500 limit; visualComponents ['cultivation-trial'], the existing ex15 drawing, which already draws preparing, placed, uncovered, planted, established and dead plots). Modes: inspect, plant, inspect-progress, maintain, cancel. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living plant of the same food. A plant's stock and another person's unit are refused, because the reference must be owned. x, y name a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil, under the same site, moisture (0.3-1.2), 0.6 m spacing and fewer-than-3-plants-within-5-m checks as ex17. Every check runs before any cost. Round 1, loosen (1 energy): escrows the unit, still carried, owned and ageing, and creates the plot (cultivation-site-prepared). Round 2, place (1 energy): rechecks reach, site, unit and energy, then moves the reserved unit with its origin, mass and age into the open plot as an unowned stack reserved for the plot that cannot be eaten or used. It records placedAt and the decay at transfer; the plot is not yet a seedling (cultivation-unit-placed; the view shows the unit). Round 3, cover (1 energy): gives the plot exactly the seedling data that the dispersal law gives a natural propagule, starts the hidden production ledger and completes the job (cultivation-propagule-planted, with no qualified flag, so planting earns no practice milestone; no food is created). After covering, the unchanged ecology runs, as in ex17. Establishment accumulates only from actual temperature, light, soil and climate moisture, waterlogging and season; in the tests it equals a natural control seedling round for round. At threshold 12 (60 for woody plants) the unit is absorbed into the new plant (cultivation-plot-established). Stock grows one unit per source interval (18 for start-0-roots) up to min(4, source capacity) (cultivation-crop-matured), and anyone harvests it with unchanged gather (2 energy per unit). If the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies (cultivation-trial-failed). The ledger records rounds, qualifying rounds, establishment, growth and units produced and removed; stock always equals produced minus removed. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) checks a unit (and with x, y a site) without consuming or reserving it, reporting decay, condition, treatment, origin, buds 'not represented', viability 'unknown' and whether it can be planted. Inspecting a plant source or plot uses the baseline probe. Inspect-progress compares the visible plot state with the person's previous look ('changed' or 'inconclusive') and reports the 120-round window with checks every 10 rounds. All records are unverified, and an uncovered unit's visible condition is reported. Maintain is refused before any cost with an explicit reason: the world has no water resource, container or transfer method; no fertilizer or amendment exists; and the plant rules keep 0.6 m around a plot clear, so no obstruction or surface condition can be changed by hand. Lifecycle: a round in which the work is not continued pauses it, and too little energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge (cultivation-work-paused). Plant resumes the person's own work and pays only the remaining rounds (cultivation-work-resumed). A lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel is planter-only, takes one round and no energy: before placing it returns the unit once and clears the loosened site (cultivation-trial-ended); after placing it leaves the unit uncovered in the plot. Death before placing leaves the unit where the person died; after placing the unit stays uncovered in its plot. Nothing is refunded. Modeling assumptions. (1) The species recipe is the existing general plant law, which supplies the executable thresholds the specification asks for: a whole, untreated, unspoiled unit from a living plant of the same food is the propagule, as one dispersed stock unit is. Planting moisture is 0.3-1.2; growth depends on temperature (root minimum 3, optimum 16), light, moisture, waterlogging and season; the establishment threshold is 12; the regeneration interval is the source's; capacity is min(4, source capacity); harvestable mass is stock times 0.4; and the buried unit keeps its food ageing (root lifetime 240). (2) Living regenerative tissue and viability are not represented on harvested units. Inspection says so, and whether a unit roots is decided only by the ecology or by rotting; a failed plot is evidence about that specimen only, not about all roots. (3) Water and nutrients act in that law only as rate factors, so the ledger is the environmental flux accounting and no pool is debited: a plot-only pool would make planted plots grow differently from natural seedlings. (4) The specification's atomic subtraction at placement is implemented as escrow: the whole unit is split from its stack at loosening as a reserved, still-owned portion, and at placement that portion leaves the inventory into the plot in one step. (5) A placed but uncovered unit is exposed material: it keeps only its food ageing and never enters the establishment law, so cancel or death after placing leaves an uncovered plot that dies when the unit rots. Recovery or removal of a placed unit is not implemented, as the specification allows. (6) The specification names only the first 10-round observation interval; later checks repeat it through the 120-round window. Both are a schedule, and inspections are allowed at any time. (7) Hand work needs no tool and is limited to ordinary meadow soil; forest floor, hard, dry or wet ground is refused at no cost, and soil moisture is read locally. Wren's current position is within 5 m of at least three root plants (start-0-roots, commons-root-3-0, commons-root-4-1), so the existing crowding rule refuses planting there at no cost and Wren must use a clearer meadow site. (8) start-0-roots is a living plant (interval 18) with stock 0. Its roots already in Wren's inventory are plantable; the commons plants' stock is not owned and needs travel and gather. (9) Incentives are on in this scope, and only the existing experience implementation applies. The package adds no satisfaction source and writes no reward or account. Records are unverified, so no information-confirmed event is made, and the existing probe information rule applies unchanged. The planting event is unqualified, so the automatically installed practice rule never fires on planting. The plot carries createdBy null like every plant (observers see only public plant fields; the record and ledger stay hidden), so the existing work-noticed rule does not count it. The review's optional maintained satisfaction for tending or harvest was not added. (10) Death leaves unplaced material on the ground because the world has no estate. Reuse: long-plant-cultivation.ts builds all three packages from one factory. New optional variant fields (stages 3, care mode 'maintain', trial tend null) select the ex18 paths: placing round, uncovered state, cancel and death texts, maintenance refusal. The new lifecycles ('placed', 'uncovered') never occur with two stages. ex16 cultivate-plants@1 and ex17 plant-cultivation@1 serialize to byte-identical packages (SHA-256 unchanged), and the ex16 and ex17 test files pass unchanged. Further reuse: ex15 cultivation-trial@1 (three-round loosen, place, cover design, law constants, predicates, footprint, reach and drawing); open-ecology.ts; forest-environment.ts ageing; long-planting-site.ts; collective-work.ts escrow, paid work and stop; open-foundation.ts probe and personal records; base gather. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex18-plant-establishment-trial.test.ts, built with initialLongWorld('long-ex18', 'long-culture-v2-incentives')) cover: scope separation from ex16 and ex17, unique handlers, the size limit and excluded vocabulary; three-round study; the three 1-energy rounds with an owned root from start-0-roots at stock 0; conservation; hidden fields; establishment equal to a natural control, the ledger and gather harvest; rot failure and progress looks; refusals of maintenance, unsuitable units, sites, unowned inputs and requests without spending; unit, site and plant-source inspection without consumption; pause, resume and planter-only cancel; uncovered placement after cancel and death; and no reward under the existing incentives.
